headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 中信证券：银行全年绝对收益空间仍将延续
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月4日讯，中信证券研报表示，基本面视角，预计二季度银行息差表现良好、资本市场和财富业务驱动中收增长，在此背景下银行营收增速保持稳定良好态势，盈利增速或将小幅上行。投资视角看，上周银行板块延续7月以来的积极趋势，但受市场风格影响周内指数大幅波动。中信证券预计，未来两周A股波动率仍将保持偏高水平，银行板块相对收益或将走弱；但经营格局稳定和宏观叙事等长逻辑仍在继续演绎，全年绝对收益空间仍将延续。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Banks' Full-Year Absolute Return Space to Persist
headlines.summary_en: Cailian Press, Aug 4 - CITIC Securities research report says, from a fundamentals perspective, bank interest margins are expected to perform well in Q2, with capital markets and wealth management businesses driving fee income growth. In this context, bank revenue growth is expected to remain stable and solid, while profit growth may rise slightly. From an investment perspective, the banking sector continued its positive trend since July last week, but experienced significant intraday index volatility due to market style shifts. CITIC Securities expects A-share volatility to remain at elevated levels over the next two weeks, with the banking sector's relative returns potentially weakening; however, the long-term narratives of stable operating patterns and macro dynamics continue to play out, and absolute returns for the full year should persist.

headlines.title: 【A股温度计】情绪指标统计：成交量再次跌破2万亿，但杠杆率升至10个月新高
headlines.summary:

2、8月3日衡量A股杠杆水平的融资买入额占A股流动市值之比大幅升至12.21%，为去年10月以来最高，年内一直围绕着10%波动，5月以来波动明显加剧。
--------
注：1、两市成交量反映了各大机构、游资、广大散户对A股看法，高于均线代表总成交量升高，市场情绪偏乐观，低于均线代表总成交量下降，市场情绪降温。
2、2015年以来，A股杠杆水平大部分时候维持在6%-10%，杠杆率超过10%意味着市场活跃

headlines.summary: 金十数据8月4日讯，中信证券研报表示，2026年8月3日，国家发改委、能源局发布《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》。作为电力领域顶层文件，《规划》与《可再生能源“十五五”规划》《新型能源体系建设“十五五”规划》等形成配套，以“源网荷储”一体化协同为主线，推动电力行业从单一新增新能源装机转向全域统筹。《规划》围绕电源、电网、调节资源、负荷、市场等设置量化目标，力争2030年初步建成新型电力系统，非化石能源发电量占比升至50%。中信证券认为，政策或将持续利好特高压、配网智能化、各类储能、虚拟电厂等灵活调节资源、清洁电源开发及电力数字化领域，并加速容量补偿机制

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Policies Likely to Continue Benefiting UHV, Grid Intelligence, Energy Storage, Virtual Power Plants, and Other Sectors
headlines.summary_en: Cailian Press, Aug 4 - CITIC Securities research report says, on August 3, 2026, the NDRC and the National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Building a New Power System. As a top-level document in the power sector, the Plan is coordinated with the 15th Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy and the 15th Five-Year Plan for New Energy System Construction, centered on 'source-grid-load-storage' integrated coordination, pushing the power industry from merely adding new renewable capacity to holistic planning. The Plan sets quantitative targets across power sources, grids, regulation resources, loads, and markets, aiming for initial completion of a new power system by 2030, with non-fossil power generation share rising to 50%. CITIC Securities believes the policy will continue to benefit UHV, smart distribution grids, various energy storage, virtual power plants and other flexible regulation resources, clean power development, and power digitalization, while accelerating capacity compensation mechanisms.

headlines.title: 风险逐步释放，公募基金新发热情升温
headlines.summary: 公募基金发行持续回暖。公募排排网统计数据显示，按认购起始日统计，本周（8月3日-8月9日），全市场共计有29家公募机构有产品发行，合计发行产品35只，环比上周增幅达118.75%，数量创下近三周新高。从投资类型来看，权益类基金占据主导地位，本周开启募集的权益类基金有21只，占总量的60%。业内人士认为，市场风险得到一定程度释放之后，公募布局热情有所回升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Risks gradually unwinding, public fund issuance enthusiasm warms up
headlines.summary_en: Public fund issuance continues to recover. According to statistics from PaiPai Wang, based on subscription start dates, this week (Aug 3-Aug 9), a total of 29 public fund institutions have products launching, with 35 products in total, up 118.75% week-on-week, hitting a three-week high. By investment type, equity funds dominate, with 21 equity funds starting fundraising this week, accounting for 60% of the total. Industry insiders believe that after market risks have been released to a certain extent, public fund allocation enthusiasm has picked up. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: “创新+出海”驱动，A股生物医药公司盈利能力提升
headlines.summary: 2026年上半年，A股生物医药公司整体盈利能力显著提升，在韧性发展中交出亮眼的成绩单，创新驱动与国内外市场拓展成为业绩增长的核心动力。截至8月3日，104家A股生物医药公司披露了上半年业绩情况（含半年报、业绩预告等）。从预告净利润增幅下限来看，有67家公司预计净利润增长（包括扭亏、减亏）。此外，药明康德、沃华医药、泽璟制药等10家公司披露半年报，其中7家实现净利润同比增长或扭亏。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Driven by 'innovation + going global,' profitability of A-share biopharmaceutical companies improves
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, A-share biopharmaceutical companies saw significantly improved overall profitability, delivering strong results amid resilient development, with innovation-driven growth and domestic and overseas market expansion becoming core drivers. As of Aug 3, 104 A-share biopharmaceutical companies disclosed H1 results (including interim reports and earnings forecasts). Based on the lower limit of forecast net profit growth, 67 companies expect net profit growth (including turning profitable and narrowing losses). Additionally, 10 companies including WuXi AppTec, Wohua Pharmaceutical, and Zelgen Pharmaceuticals disclosed interim reports, with 7 achieving year-on-year net profit growth or turning profitable. (Shanghai Securities News)
